jp: このが人狼？なかなか面白い推理。小説家にでもなったらどう？
jp_grezzo: "この" + _ore(3) + "が人狼？なかなか面白い推理" + _da(3) + "。小説家にでもなったらどう" + _kana(3) + "？"
en: That's an interesting deduction. I recommend you to become a novelist.
en_grezzo: "That's an interesting deduction. I recommend you to become a novelist."
it: Una deduzione interessante. Ti consiglio di darti alla narrativa.

jp: 馬鹿馬鹿しい。ここに人狼なんているわけない、確率的に考えて。いたら、かなりのレアケース。
jp_grezzo: "馬鹿馬鹿しい。ここに人狼なんているわけない" + _daro(3) + "、確率的に考えて。いたら、かなりのレアケース" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Ridiculous. There's no way there'd be a werewolf here. Think about it, they're quite rare.
en_grezzo: "Ridiculous. There's no way there'd be a werewolf here. Think about it, they're quite rare."
it: Ridicolo. Non è possibile che qui ci sia un lupo mannaro. Pensaci: sono piuttosto rari.

jp: ち、違う！は人狼じゃない、信じて！
jp_grezzo: "ち、違う！" + _ore(3) + "は人狼じゃない" + _yo(3) + "、信じて" + _kure(3) + "！"
en: I-I'm not! I'm not a werewolf! Please believe me!
en_grezzo: "I-I'm not! I'm not a werewolf! Please believe me!"
it: N-non è vero! Io non sono un lupo mannaro! Devi credermi!

jp: 処刑は1日に1回まで。無駄にしないよう、色々な可能性を考慮してから決めるといい。
jp_grezzo: "処刑は1日に1回まで" + _da(3) + "。無駄にしないよう、色々な可能性を考慮してから決めるといい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: You can only execute one person a day. If you don't want to be wasteful, you should consider all the possibilities.
en_grezzo: "You can only execute one person a day. If you don't want to be wasteful, you should consider all the possibilities."
it: Si può giustiziare una persona sola al giorno. Se non vuoi sprecare l'occasione, valuta bene tutte le possibilità.

jp: どうしてにその質問をしたのか気になる。答えられないならが人狼側と勘繰られても仕方ない。
jp_grezzo: "どうして" + _ore(3) + "にその質問をしたのか気になる" + _yo(3) + "。答えられないなら" + _kimi(3) + "が人狼側と勘繰られても仕方ない" + _nda(3) + "。"
en: Why even bother asking? Even if I say no, you're still going to be suspicious of me.
en_grezzo: "Why even bother asking? Even if I say no, you're still going to be suspicious of me."
it: Perché me lo chiedi? Anche se ti dico di no, continuerai a sospettare di me.

jp: もしを処刑することでこの街のためになる情報が得られるのなら、吊ればいい。
jp_grezzo: "もし" + _ore(3) + "を処刑することでこの街のためになる情報が得られるのなら、吊ればいい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: If you have evidence saying I should be executed then do something already.
en_grezzo: "If you have evidence saying I should be executed then do something already."
it: Se hai le prove per mandarmi al patibolo, allora muoviti.

jp: そういえば、あまり見ない顔の人が一人いた。でも人狼じゃなくて狐って可能性もある？
jp_grezzo: "そういえば、あまり見ない顔の人が一人いた" + _yo(3) + "。でも人狼じゃなくて狐って可能性もある" + _kana(3) + "？"
en: Come to think of it, there is someone I haven't seen before. But maybe it's a kitsune instead of a werewolf?
en_grezzo: "Come to think of it, there is someone I haven't seen before. But maybe it's a kitsune instead of a werewolf?"
it: A pensarci bene, c'era una faccia mai vista prima. Ma forse è una volpe ammaliatrice, non un lupo mannaro?
Questa persona è un lupo mannaro!

jp: に疑いの目が向けられた。
jp_grezzo: "" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + "に疑いの目が向けられた。"
contesto: txt lang("" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + "に疑いの目が向けられた。", cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, tc) + " was suspected around.")

jp: 身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうもは正真正銘の人間のよう
jp_grezzo: "身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうも" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + "は正真正銘の人間のよう" + _da()

en_grezzo: "From what we've gathered from our investigation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " is most definitely a genuine human."
contesto: chatMore lang("身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうも" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + "は正真正銘の人間のよう" + _da(), "From what we've gathered from our investigation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " is most definitely a genuine human.")
it: "Da quel che abbiamo raccolto con le indagini, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " è un essere umano in tutto e per tutto."

jp: 現在は特に調査している人物はいない
jp_grezzo: "現在は特に調査している人物はいない" + _na()
it: Al momento non stiamo indagando su nessuno.
